name: slack-send
description: Publish a message in a channel or send a JSON payload to the Slack Workflow Builder

channel-id.description: Slack channel ID where message will be posted. Needed if using bot token

slack-message.description: Message to post into Slack. Needed if using bot token

payload.description: JSON payload to send to Slack if webhook route. If not supplied, json from GitHub event will be sent instead

payload-file-path.description: path to JSON payload to send to Slack if webhook route. If not supplied, json from GitHub event will be sent instead. If payload is provided, it will take prefe

payload-file-path-parsed.description: Replace templated variables in the JSON payload file with values from the GitHub context and environment variables

update-ts.description: The timestamp of a previous message posted. It will update the existing message instead of posting a new message
